mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications ( receiver_id, sender_id, post_id, comment_id, type, message, is_read, created_at ) VALUES ( #{receiverId}, #{senderId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{postId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{commentId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{type, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{message}, #{isRead}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT n.*, m.nickname as sender_nickname FROM notifications n LEFT JOIN members m ON n.sender_id = m.member_id WHERE n.notification_id = #{notificationId}
SELECT n.*, m.nickname as sender_nickname FROM notifications n LEFT JOIN members m ON n.sender_id = m.member_id WHERE n.receiver_id = #{receiverId} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = 'Y', read_at = SYSDATE WHERE notification_id = #{notificationId} AND is_read = 'N'
UPDATE notifications SET is_read = 'Y', read_at = SYSDATE WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = 'N'
